newsitem.title: USA: D&P maintains GM senior debt rating A-minus.
newsitem.headline: D&P maintains GM senior debt rating A-minus.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it maintains its single-A-minus rating on the senior debt and triple-B-plus rating on preference stock of General Motors Corp.
The action follows announcement that Hughes Electronics Corp, a GM subsidiary, and PanAmSat Corp agreed to merge their respective satellite services operations into a new company.
Because government review and approvals are expected to take six to 12 months, D&P said it does not expect any financial impact on GM until late first quarter 1997 at the earliest.

The $1.5 billion cash payout plus the assumption of PanAmSat debt should have little credit impact on GM, it said. Whatever impact there is should be lessened as the new company generates cash flow and makes efforts to reduce debt, D&P said.

The merger would combine the leading provider of commercial video, voice and data satellite communications in the United States with a large privately held satellite system and is consistent with Hughes's strategy of expanding its presence in the satellite-based communications services, it said.
Hughes shares are trading up 3-1/4 to 61 and PanAmSat shares are off 1/8 to 27-5/8.
